description: B holds 20 rows. For a table-type, a dynaset, a snapshot and a forward-only recordset over B and each value [Long 1 ;; Long 2 ;; Long 10 ;; Long 20 ;; Long 21 ;; Long 0 ;; Long -1 ;; Long 1000 ;; "3" ;; Double 2.5 ;; Null ;; Empty]: (a) a fresh recordset with the value assigned to AbsolutePosition at once; read BOF, EOF, AbsolutePosition, PercentPosition, ID and RecordCount; (b) one recordset after MoveLast (reads are RecordCount first), assigning each value in turn and reading the same. Asks the base of the index, the out-of-range and type-coercion policy, the state after a refused assignment, and which types accept it. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
